items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Of course, he and Al Cohn worked together all the time.

ctx.x: Do you want to talk a little bit about Zoot? Does he fit in here in this time?

Yeah. Zoot Sims. Of course, he and Al Cohn worked together all the time. Zoot was… his, his time sense was just outrageous, swinging. Just incredible. I’m looking at a picture of Zoot kinda hunched over there, right next to your grandpa’s picture.
